subject: ACME Health sponsorship — compiled impact summary & proposed credit
summary: Post-sponsorship ROI analysis for Acme Health. Compiled lead funnel, flagged 9/22 leads as ineligible (duplicate or no demo intent), estimated influenced pipeline $178,000, recommending a partial credit and a HubSpot attribution correction. Seeking sales leadership approval for a $12,000 credit and partner-split guidance.
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rhodes <alex.rhodes@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACME Health — quick follow up and promised impact summary

Alex — thanks again for sponsoring the Redwood Spring Summit last week. We appreciated the high-energy booth and your team’s demo sessions. I said we’d follow up with a concise impact summary — attaching a short workbook with the lead detail and the topline funnel.

Quick highlights up front: 22 leads attributed to Acme in HubSpot; of those we’ve classified 13 as valid MQLs (based on demo intent and verified contact). The rest are duplicates or missing key qualification signals. Of the 13, 5 converted to SQL and three have entered influenced pipeline (~$178k TEV).

I want to be transparent about the numbers and propose a pragmatic path forward: a partial sponsorship credit to reconcile the discrepancy in lead quality plus a small partner split to reflect co-marketing. I’ll loop back with our internal team this week and send a finalized note by Monday.

If you’d like to review the workbook together, happy to block 20 mins — propose Tues 6/9 10am PT.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachment: 20260610-acme-impact-workbook.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12 sheets)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: DRAFT: Acme impact workbook + recommendation (internal)

Team — attaching the draft workbook (sheet order: raw_leads, qualification_notes, funnel_rollup, pipeline_touchpoints). Key findings summarized here: 

- Raw leads attributed: 22 (HubSpot event import)
- Valid MQLs after review: 13
- SQLs: 5
- Deals influenced (open/closed-won pipeline): 3 opportunities, TEV $178,000 (two in dev, one closed-won this week for $32,000)
- Attribution issues: 4 duplicates, 5 low-fit (vendor marketing, non-decision makers), tagging errors from the event import script caused 2 leads to be assigned to the wrong rep.

Proposed remediation: 
1) HubSpot correction: reassign 2 leads to correct owners and mark 4 as duplicates (remove from Acme count).
2) Financial adjustment: offer Acme a partial sponsorship credit of $12,000 (about 20% of the total sponsorship fee) to reflect the net quality delta and the misattribution we introduced.
3) Partner split: suggest Redwood provide a 10% co-marketing credit for joint nurture work (makes the net credit to Acme effectively $10,800 post-split).
4) Process fixes: update the event import script, add a two-step manual verification for HubSpot imports, and require a single internal owner for event lead reconciliation within 48 hours post-event.

Decision required: sign-off from Sales Leadership and Finance on the $12k credit and approval to issue a revised invoice/credit memo. Also need Marketing Ops to push the HubSpot changes.

Attachments: 20260610-acme-impact-workbook.xlsx

Jonas
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DRAFT: Acme impact workbook + recommendation (internal)

Thanks for the thorough breakdown — quick notes: 

- I agree with the HubSpot corrections; I can own the import fixes with Ops but will need a formal change ticket.
- Financially, $12k seems reasonable relative to the sponsorship fee and the influenced pipeline. Recommend we split the difference with product marketing: authorize $12k credit but hold $4k in reserve pending the final confirmed pipeline motions (i.e., if both remaining opps convert, reduce the credit by $4k).
- We should also offer Acme a 60-day nurture campaign co-run (emails + 1 joint webinar) as a non-cash make-good — drives pipeline and reduces revenue friction.

If no objections, I’ll draft a short email to Finance and CC Legal to prepare the credit memo and the DocuSign amendment.

—Ben
Senior Account Executive
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rhodes <alex.rhodes@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Samantha Chen <s.chen@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Acme sponsorship impact & proposed remediation

Alex / Samantha — please find the final impact summary and our proposed remediation attached. Short version up top: after a manual review we classify 13 of 22 leads as valid. The activity influenced three opportunities (TEV $178,000). We acknowledge the import/tagging errors and want to make this right.

What we are proposing: 
- A $12,000 partial credit against the sponsorship fee; $4,000 of that will be held in reserve and contingent on the status of two open influenced opportunities (if both convert to closed-won within 90 days, the reserve will be released back to Redwood).
- A 10% co-marketing credit to support a 60-day nurture program (we’ll co-create the sequence).
- HubSpot corrections completed (Ben will file the change ticket and update ownerships this week).

Next steps requested from you: please confirm you’re comfortable with the above framework and indicate whether you’d like the DocuSign amendment for the credit memo now or after the 90-day reserve window. Link to our draft DocuSign: https://redwood.docs/docusign/ACME-CREDIT-2026

Thanks again for a great event partnership — we want to preserve the relationship and make sure the commercial outcome matches the value delivered. If you’d like a short call to walk the workbook, Marissa and I are available Thurs 6/17 11am PT.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
